projection.instruction: Read `simulation_results` and `execution_results`. Return `post_execution_diagnostic` as an object decorating the existing simulated checklist without regenerating its items. `checklist` retains the same entries in the same order. Each `condition_id`, `expected`, and `simulated` preserves the original value, and `passed` preserves the simulation's Boolean prediction. `actual` describes the observed condition. `status` is exactly `pass`, `fail`, or `unverified`. `discrepancy` describes differences between expected and actual results, or is empty if none exists; it supersedes the earlier predicted discrepancy. `evidence` is an array of supporting observations or verification results. `overall_result` is `pass` only when every item passes, `fail` when a verified discrepancy exists, or `incomplete` when verification remains unresolved without an established failure. Verify the actual deliverable against the accepted requirements. Report failures and unresolved requirements explicitly.

final_schema.description: Response object containing the current state input under the semantic keyword post_execution_diagnostic. Earlier accepted inputs remain in the iterator's separate indexed records.

post_execution_diagnostic.description: The `post_execution_diagnostic` property is an object containing post-execution diagnostic outcomes and the overall result.

checklist.description: The `post_execution_diagnostic.checklist` property is an array containing every item of `simulation_results.checklist` in the same order, with preserved prior values and added observed results.

expected.description: The `post_execution_diagnostic.checklist[].expected` property is a string preserved exactly from the corresponding `simulation_results.checklist[].expected`.

simulated.description: The `post_execution_diagnostic.checklist[].simulated` property is a string preserved exactly from the corresponding `simulation_results.checklist[].simulated`.
simulated.const: Check against both profile bindings and the revised conditional edges.

passed.description: The post_execution_diagnostic.checklist item passed property preserves the original Boolean simulation prediction for this checklist condition.

actual.description: The `post_execution_diagnostic.checklist[].actual` property is a string describing the observed post-execution condition.

status.description: The `post_execution_diagnostic.checklist[].status` property is a string with exactly one of pass, fail, or unverified, describing whether the actual result satisfies the requirement.

discrepancy.description: The `post_execution_diagnostic.checklist[].discrepancy` property is a string explaining any actual discrepancy from the required condition, or an empty string when none exists.

evidence.description: The `post_execution_diagnostic.checklist[].evidence` property is an array of strings recording evidence for the assessed condition.

items.description: Each string in `post_execution_diagnostic.checklist[].evidence` describes an observation or verification result supporting the post-execution assessment.
